biggest_catch: Wharton Behavioral Lab publishes an official rate ($15.00/hour on-campus; $2-$6 remote) but no official payment timing — nothing states when the Virtual ClinCard is funded after a session — and no official session-duration range.
catches: No official payout deadline or ClinCard funding timing.
Payment requires a valid U.S. social security number and completed W-8/W9; ClinCard must be activated before bank transfer.
Remote studies pay only $2-$6 per study.

c1.evidence: Official participants page confirms a paid program: 'Participants are paid via Virtual ClinCard at a rate of $15.00/hour for on-campus studies and $2 to $6 for remote studies.' (wbl.wharton.upenn.edu/participants/)

c2.evidence: Official rate exists ($15.00/hour on-campus; $2-$6 remote), but no official payout timing means it cannot be framed as fast cash.

c3.evidence: No payout-timing commitment in official terms.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; participants are paid.

eligibility: Must register on Sona, complete prescreen questions, have a valid U.S. social security number and submitted W-8/W9; can only participate once per session
maximize: Only join a study whose Sona listing states the session length and ClinCard funding timing in writing — the official rate is real but the pay date is not, and remote studies pay just $2-$6.
notes: Official pages (wbl.wharton.upenn.edu) fetched 2026-09-23. Rate is published, but with no official payout timing or duration the route fails the fast-cash evidence bar.

s3.note: Eligibility stated officially: Sona registration, SSN, W-8/W9.

s4.note: No fee; paid via Virtual ClinCard.

s5.note: Flow documented: register, prescreen, attend session, paid (timing unstated).

s6.note: Rate disclosed upfront; timing not disclosed.

s7.note: Ongoing pool; studies posted on Sona.
